fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects usage of Gpg4win to decrypt files
fields.name: File Decryption Using Gpg4win
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (((tgt.process.image.path contains "\\gpg.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\gpg2.exe") or tgt.process.displayName="GnuPG’s OpenPGP tool") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains " -d " and tgt.process.cmdline contains "passphrase")))
